item.title: WTL: Suresh Stuns Medvedev In Thriller To Secure Final Spot (Ld)
item.description: Aussie Mavericks Kites: India’s Dhakshineswar Suresh, playing for the Aussie Mavericks Kites, delivered the knockout blow as he defeated Daniil Medvedev, the Grand Slam champion, 6-4 in the last set to take his team to Saturday’s summit clash of the World Tennis League.

item.title: Kabir Khan Encounters A Little Smriti Mandhana Fan In Kashmir, Cricketer Reacts
item.description: Filmmaker Kabir Khan: Filmmaker Kabir Khan had a very special encounter during his latest visit to Kashmir.

item.title: Inter Milan Lose To Bologna On Penalties In Italian Super Cup SF
item.description: Italian Super Cup SF: Inter Milan knocked out of the Supercoppa Italiana after losing to Bologna on penalties in the semifinal.

item.title: Dubai Capitals Secure Crushing 63-Run Victory Over Sharjah Warriorz in ILT20 Clash
item.description: Dubai Capitals defeated Sharjah Warriorz by 63 runs for their first-ever ILT20 win over them. Atal’s fifty and Nabi’s all-round show powered the big victory.

item.title: Kalinga Lancers Appoint Sanjay And Arthur Van Doren As Co-captains Ahead Of HIL 2026
item.description: Sultan Azlan Shah Cup: Ahead of the upcoming Hockey India League season, Kalinga Lancers announced on Saturday the appointment of India’s Sanjay and Belgium stalwart Arthur Van Doren as co-captains of the team.

item.title: Tom Jones To Lead New Zealand In ICC U19 World Cup
item.description: U19 Cricket World Cup: Opening batter Tom Jones will captain New Zealand's 15-strong squad, which includes five domestic stars, for 2026 ICC Men’s Under-19 Cricket World Cup, hosted by Zimbabwe and Namibia, scheduled to take place across Zimbabwe and Namibia from 15 January to 6 February.

item.title: Top Players Gear Up For Thailand Tennis Masters In February
item.description: The Lawn Tennis Association: The Lawn Tennis Association of Thailand (LTAT) has announced that the Thailand Tennis Masters 2026 will be held in February 2026 at the National Tennis Development Center in Muang Thong Thani, Nonthaburi. The international tournament is expected to bring together top tennis players from around the world alongside leading Thai athletes, marking a significant boost for the country’s tennis landscape.

item.title: Hardik’s Energy On The Field Is Exactly Like Sir Viv Richards: Uthappa
item.description: Sir Viv Richards: Former India batter Robin lauded Hardik Pandya’s energy on the field and compared him to the legendary Vivian Richards after the Indian all-rounder’s all-round show helped India clinch a victory against South Africa in the five-match T20I series 3-1 with a comprehensive 30-run win in the fifth T20I at Ahmedabad.

item.title: BAI To Conduct First-ever Grassroots Para Badminton Coaches Development Programme
item.description: The Badminton Association: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is hosting its inaugural Coaches Development Program - Para Badminton (Grassroot) in Raipur from December 16 to 20. This marks a major step in enhancing the coaching infrastructure that supports the sport’s quick growth in the country.

item.title: You Can't Let Bumrah Bowl Four Overs Without Damage: Steyn
item.description: Many South Africans: Former pace legend Dale Steyn was full of praise for India pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah after the team’s commanding performance in the fifth and final T20I against South Africa that set the stage for the Men in Blue’s 3-1 series win on Friday as the hosts clinched a 30-run victory.
